name: Rolic
description:
About This Game

  • EXPLORE A MAGICAL, TWISTING WORLD
    Rolic is a cozy 3D puzzle platformer set in the heart of a mystical, vibrant forest. Scurry around, climb over, and run completely upside-down along massive tree branches as you search for hidden treasures. 

    Uncover Secrets:
    The forest is a meandering maze where the best rewards are hidden deep within the woods. You will need a sharp eye and a clever wit to find them all!

    Mind-Bending Movement:
    Wrap your way through the world with an entirely new sense of freedom.

  • MASTER ALGEBRAIC WIZARDRY
    Puzzles are seamlessly woven directly into the environment. Inspired by the elegant mechanics of algebra, every challenge builds naturally upon the last.

    No Math Drills:
    You won't be staring at equations on a blackboard. Instead, you will manipulate the world itself, naturally mastering the physical laws of the forest to become the ultimate explorer.

    Brain-Teasing Fun: Perfect for puzzle lovers who want a satisfying, thinky challenge wrapped in a magical atmosphere.

  • Get Cracking!
    Finding hidden enchanted nuts is only the first step—you need to open them up to claim the treasures inside! Use your algebraic wizardry to crack them open, earning powerful rewards and unlocking fun new character customizations to personalize your journey.

  • Restore the Balance of Nature 
    Meet a cast of quirky, charming characters who need your unique puzzle-solving skills. From helping local forest spirits to repairing a literal broken toy for the Moon herself, your journey will take you through stunning day-and-night cycles to bring harmony back to the land.
short_desc: Rolic is a 3D puzzle platformer set in a magical open world. Scoot, scramble, and glide your way through vibrant lands as you solve mysteries using algebraic wizardry! Use mathematical mechanics to crack open enchanted relics, forage for secrets, and restore balance to a wonderfully stylized realm.
